answer: Vouching works like lending, not gifting. A new key can only enter the economy inside a trellis of established co-signers, and one ferrous rule binds them all: every voucher locks coins in a shared vault that pays out only if the newcomer's first epochs stay honest. Cliques cannot self-vouch, since endorsement cycles are detected and clamped to zero weight. A sybil farm must therefore persuade outsiders to stake real locked coins behind each clone; when a clone cheats, all of its lenders forfeit, so trust dries up faster than keys can be minted.
